sources.title: Pausing AI Developments Isn't Enough. We Need to Shut It All Down
sources.quote_checked: This 6-month moratorium would be better than no moratorium. | understating the seriousness of the situation and asking for too little to solve it | Progress in AI capabilities is running vastly, vastly ahead of progress in AI alignment. | if you get that wrong on the first try, you do not get to learn from your mistakes, because you are dead | We are not ready. We are not on track to be significantly readier in the foreseeable future. | be less scared of a shooting conflict between nations than of the moratorium being violated | There's no proposed plan for how we could do any such thing and survive.
